title: Tencent Slashes Investment in Yuanbao as WeChat AI Assistant Xiaowei Reaches 30 Million Daily Active Users
excerpt: Tencent Holdings disclosed its third-quarter 2026 earnings report on November 18. According to media reports from outlets such as IT Home and Changan Street Zhi
content_html:
Tencent Holdings disclosed its third-quarter 2026 earnings report on November 18. According to media reports from outlets such as IT Home and Changan Street Zhishi, Tencent's revenue for the quarter reached RMB 207.336 billion, up 8% year on year; Non-IFRS operating profit was RMB 68.073 billion, down 6% year on year. However, excluding the contribution from new AI products, operating profit on a like-for-like basis was RMB 83.3 billion, up 8% year on year. At the earnings call that followed, Tencent President Martin Lau gave a clear signal about the company's consumer-facing AI product strategy.

Yuanbao falls short of expectations; investment sharply cut as focus shifts to model capabilities

In response to outside attention on the development of its AI assistant, Martin Lau admitted at the earnings call that the consumer-facing AI assistant "Yuanbao" had not met the company's expectations. "As you can all see, Yuanbao has not been as successful as we expected."

Martin Lau said Yuanbao is no longer purely pursuing user-scale growth targets, but is instead shifting its focus back to improving underlying model capabilities, and progress in this direction is currently going well. At the same time, Tencent has significantly reduced its financial investment in Yuanbao.

Looking back at Yuanbao's development, the product officially launched in May 2024. To expand its reach, Tencent last year offered a limited-time download entry for Yuanbao within WeChat; during this year's Spring Festival, Yuanbao also ran a promotional campaign to "give away RMB 1 billion in cash red packets." After the campaign ended on February 18, Tencent announced that Yuanbao's daily active users had exceeded 50 million and its monthly active users had reached 114 million.

WeChat's "Xiaowei" accelerates expanded testing, reaches 30 million DAU with lower costs

While adjusting its investment in Yuanbao, Tencent is further advancing the rollout of "Xiaowei," an AI assistant within the WeChat ecosystem. Martin Lau revealed that Tencent is continuing to expand the user testing pool for WeChat's "Xiaowei," and its daily active users have now reached 30 million.

On cost control, Martin Lau pointed out that the quarterly operating cost of WeChat's "Xiaowei" after its full launch will be lower than Yuanbao's quarterly cost earlier this year. As its product matrix adjusts and priorities shift, Tencent's approach to its AI business is showing a greater emphasis on efficiency and the underlying model foundation.
